questions.question_english: What is “Input Tax Credit” (ITC) in the context of GST?
options_english: The tax a school collects from students
A direct capital subsidy provided by the government to schools for IT equipment.
Setting off tax paid on inputs against output tax liability.
An exemption granted to contractors dealing with government schools
questions.explanation_english: Input Tax Credit under Goods and Services Tax allows a registered business entity or supplier to reduce the tax paid on input goods or services from the tax payable on outward taxable supplies. This mechanism avoids cascading effects of taxes by ensuring that tax is charged only on value addition.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। वस्तुओं और सेवाओं पर चुकाए गए कर को आउटपुट कर देनदारी के खिलाफ घटाने की अनुमति देने वाला इनपुट टैक्स क्रेडिट, जीएसटी के तहत एक पंजीकृत व्यवसाय इकाई या आपूर्तिकर्ता को सक्षम करता है। यह तंत्र करों के चक्रवृद्धि प्रभावों से बचता है और सुनिश्चित करता है कि कर केवल मूल्य संवर्धन पर लगाया जाए।

questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT a common compliance requirement or error associated with a DDO acting in a school administration capacity?

Missing the due date for issuing Form 16 to employees

questions.explanation_english: Assessing corporate tax liabilities of external vendors is the responsibility of tax authorities, not school Drawing and Disbursing Officers. questions.question_english: A new Principal takes charge of a government school. The previous DDO has been transferred. Regarding the TAN used for filing TDS returns for the school, what should the new Principal do?
options_english: Apply immediately for a new TAN in their personal name for future school tax deductions.
Continue using the school’s existing TAN allotted to the office position.
Use their personal PAN instead of TAN to ensure accountability.
Request the previous DDO to continue filing the returns from their new posting.
questions.explanation_english: A Tax Deduction Account Number is allotted specifically to an office or designated organizational position rather than an individual officer. When a new Principal takes charge as Drawing and Disbursing Officer, they must continue utilizing the school’s existing permanent TAN for all statutory tax deductions, deposits, and quarterly return filings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एक कर कटौती खाता संख्या विशेष रूप से एक कार्यालय या नामित संगठनात्मक पद के लिए आवंटित की जाती है, न कि किसी व्यक्तिगत अधिकारी के लिए। जब एक नया प्रधानाचार्य लेखा और वितरण अधिकारी के रूप में कार्यभार संभालता है, तो उन्हें सभी वैधानिक कर कटौतियों, जमा और तिमाही रिटर्न दाखिल करने के लिए स्कूल के मौजूदा स्थायी टीएएन का उपयोग करना चाहिए।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration

questions.question_english: Under Section 51 of the CGST Act, certain entities including departments of Central and State Governments are required to deduct Tax at Source (TDS under GST) from payments made to suppliers. What is the threshold contract value above which this deduction is mandatory?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 51 of the CGST Act 2017, government departments and specified public entities are mandated to deduct Tax Deducted at Source under GST from payments made to suppliers. This requirement applies when the total value of supply under a single contract exceeds two lakh fifty thousand rupees, excluding taxes.

questions.question_english: An employee has an outstanding education loan taken for their higher studies. Under which section of the Income Tax Act can they claim a deduction for the interest paid on this loan?
options_english: Section 80C
Section 80E
Section 80D
Section 80G
questions.explanation_english: Section 80E of the Income Tax Act permits an individual taxpayer to claim a tax deduction for interest paid on an education loan. The loan must be taken from a recognized financial institution or charitable trust for higher education of the individual, spouse, children, or a student for whom they are legal guardian. This provision encourages education and helps reduce the financial burden on individuals pursuing higher studies.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 80E एक व्यक्तिगत करदाता को शिक्षा ऋण पर चुकाए गए ब्याज के लिए कर कटौती का दावा करने की अनुमति देती है। यह ऋण किसी मान्यता प्राप्त वित्तीय संस्थान या चैरिटेबल ट्रस्ट से लिया जाना चाहिए, जो व्यक्तिगत, पति/पत्नी, बच्चों या उस छात्र के लिए हो, जिसके वे कानूनी अभिभावक हैं। यह प्रावधान शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करता है और उच्च अध्ययन करने वाले व्यक्तियों पर वित्तीय बोझ को कम करने में मदद करता है।

questions.question_english: A retired Principal of a GNCTD school receives a monthly pension and subsequently passes away. The surviving spouse receives a family pension. How is this family pension treated under the Income Tax Act?
options_english: It is taxed under “Income from Other Sources” subject to deduction under Section 57(iia).
It is fully exempt from income tax under Section 10 of the Income Tax Act for surviving spouses.

questions.explanation_english: Family pension paid to the legal heir or surviving spouse of a deceased employee is taxed under Income from Other Sources because no employer-employee relationship exists. Under Section 57(iia) of the Income Tax Act, the recipient is allowed a deduction of one-third of the pension amount, which is a significant relief for the taxpayer.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। मृतक कर्मचारी के कानूनी उत्तराधिकारी या जीवित पति/पत्नी को दी जाने वाली पारिवारिक पेंशन अन्य स्रोतों से आय के तहत कर लगाई जाती है क्योंकि कोई नियोक्ता-कर्मचारी संबंध नहीं होता है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 57(iia) के तहत, प्राप्तकर्ता को पेंशन राशि का एक तिहाई कटौती की अनुमति होती है, जो करदाता के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण राहत है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Section 57(iia) allows deductions on family pensions.
